```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)


load("../Input/CA_Direct_2016-2022.RData") #SiteData 

#Irrigation fraction at ecodistrict level 
INPUT_irri <-read_xlsx("../Input/SOILEF_Irrig_Practice_Matrix.xlsx")%>% #Data from 2025 NIR
    filter(Inv_Year_ID >= 2018  & Inv_Year_ID <= 2022)%>%
    filter(Irrig_Scenario == "Irrigation") %>%
    select(-Irrig_Scenario, -Irrig_Scenario_ID)
 
SiteData <- SiteData %>%
  filter(Year >= 2018  & Year <= 2022) %>% 
  left_join(INPUT_irri, by = c("Year" = "Inv_Year_ID", "Ecodistrict" = "ECODISTRIC", 
                               "Province_ID" = "PROVINCE"))

#save(SiteData,file = "../Input/CA_Irrigation_2018-2022.RData")        
```

## N2O emissions due to irrigation

This methodology firstly determine the proportion of irrigation area in a ecodistrict and then apply a ratio factor (EF_PE/EF_P, must > 1) and then deduct 1

```{r irrigation}
source("Function for N2O EF_Irrigation.R")

Result_Irri <- SiteData %>%
  N2OEF_Irri() 

#Atlantic provinces
AT <- c("NL","NS","PE","NB")

N2O_long<- Result_Irri[[1]] %>%
  mutate (Region = case_when(         #combine the region
          Province %in% AT ~ "AT",
          TRUE ~ Province)) %>%
  group_by(Region,Crop) %>%
  summarise(Tot.Fert = sum(Tot.Fert), Tot.N2O = sum(Tot.N2O)) %>%
  mutate(N2O.IEF =  round(ifelse(Tot.Fert >0, Tot.N2O/Tot.Fert,0),8))

```


## Add sorghum, camelina, triticale data

```{r sorghum, camelina, triticale}
sorghum_rows <- N2O_long[N2O_long$Crop == "Corn", ]
# Modify the Crop column to Sorghum
sorghum_rows$Crop <- "Sorghum"

camelina_rows <- N2O_long[N2O_long$Crop == "Canola", ]
# Modify the Crop column to Sorghum
camelina_rows$Crop <- "Camelina"

triticale_rows <- N2O_long[N2O_long$Crop == "Wheat(spring)", ]
# Modify the Crop column to Sorghum
triticale_rows$Crop <- "Triticale"

N2O_long <- rbind(N2O_long, sorghum_rows, camelina_rows, triticale_rows)
N2O_long <- N2O_long[order(N2O_long$Region),]

write.csv(N2O_long,"../Output/Direct N2O_Irrigation_CA.csv",row.names = FALSE)

```
